component.name: UnifyCloud
component.summary: Multi-cloud storage manager with E2EE and auto-sync

description.p: UnifyCloud is a fast, secure, and privacy-respecting multi-cloud storage manager and synchronization tool built with Flutter and an embedded Rclone engine.

ul.li: Connect and browse multiple cloud storage providers simultaneously (Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, SFTP, S3, Nextcloud/WebDAV, and Local Storage).
Wrap any cloud remote with client-side zero-knowledge AES-256 encryption (Rclone Crypt).
Dual-pane Commander view with direct cross-cloud drag-and-drop and background transfers.
Automated scheduled backups and mirror synchronization between local folders and cloud storage.
Zero-plaintext in-memory configuration storage backed by the OS Secret Service keyring.

description.p: Security audit fixes, classic Material 3 theme restoration, and updated packaging.
Official UnifyCloud logo, updated Material 3 theme, improved multi-cloud synchronization, and security hardening.
Initial release featuring multi-cloud support, dual-pane explorer, and periodic folder backups.
